findings.summary: Adapter plan assumed a uniform runtime/tools interface even though existing scripts use source-specific parameters, dependencies, and output names.
findings.resolution: Added adapter manifest contract requirements, design guidance, normalization tasks, dependency checks, and manifest tests.

findings.summary: Deep historical detail dry-runs require existing RaceEvent rows, but the plan did not define target event preflight or seed handling.
findings.resolution: Added RaceEvent target-row preflight, missing_race_event blocker behavior, draft seed review artifact, and coverage/test tasks.

findings.summary: First acceptance needed protection against one region passing while another region fails, but fixture tests did not explicitly cover all five regions.
findings.resolution: Added five-region first-acceptance fixture test coverage for plan, adapter selection, three-module targets, and preflight results.
